title: MXene–PVA composite for arsenic removal from industrial wastewater: a combined DFT and experimental study
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,2981-2995
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09190J, Paper

MXene–PVA composites enable efficient arsenic removal through synergistic bidentate As–O–Ti coordination and hydrogen bonding, as revealed by combined DFT simulations and experimental validation in real industrial wastewater.
